_doc: Hand-maintained named projects that are not single repos. Each becomes one graph node; `links` are `owner/repo` ids of the public repos it groups (the project's commit count is the sum of Jon's commits across them, and each link is a full-weight edge). `url` is where a click goes. Edit here, then `npm run graph:data`.

projects.label: Edge wallet
projects.description: The Edge self-custody wallet: React Native app, core, currency and exchange plugins, and the servers behind them.

projects.label: Agent orchestration
projects.description: Asana tasks to pull requests without a human in the loop: a watcher spawns one Claude Code session per task, hooks enforce the workflow, a watchdog tends the sessions.

projects.label: Agent evals
projects.description: Post-hoc grading of finished agent runs against explicit rubrics, every finding carrying a citation an auditor can open.
